notes: Judicial candidates; bar ratings excluded. DeJute's site lists no endorsers on the page fetched.

anthony-a-j-bayne.text: Campaign tagline "Justice that Works for Los Angeles"; emphasizes courtroom experience and judicial temperament rather than specific policy positions.
Endorsed by SEIU Local 721, ILWU, Knock LA and LA Forward.
Endorsed by the Association of Deputy District Attorneys and the Peace Officers Research Association of California.

david-dejute.text: "Justice belongs to everyone" and "values matter" in judicial service; campaign tagline "Justice That Reflects Los Angeles," framed around "fairness, reason, and respect."
